description: This is a test source file for the WinChecker class, containing unit tests for checking win conditions and draw detection in a Tic-Tac-Toe game.

classes.name: WinCheckerTest
classes.description: Contains unit tests for the WinChecker class functionality in the Tic-Tac-Toe game.

methods.name: no winner on empty board
methods.description: Tests that no winner is detected when the board is empty.

methods.name: row win detected
methods.description: Tests that a horizontal row of the same player results in a win detection.

methods.name: column win detected
methods.description: Tests that a vertical column of the same player results in a win detection.

methods.name: diagonal win detected TL-BR
methods.description: Tests detection of a diagonal win from top-left to bottom-right.

methods.name: diagonal win detected TR-BL
methods.description: Tests detection of a diagonal win from top-right to bottom-left.

methods.name: draw is detected when full and no winner
methods.description: Tests that a full board with no winner is detected as a draw.
